query:
UPDATE users SET email=$2, password_hash=$3, display_name=$4,
            avatar_url=$5, email_verified_at=$6, mfa_enabled=$7, mfa_secret_encrypted=$8,
            status=$9, failed_login_count=$10, locked_until=$11, last_login_at=$12,
            last_login_ip=$13, updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1
